title: What is an option?
summary: Calls, puts, strike, expiry, premium and lot size, with a worked example of selling a call.

questions.q: Who receives the premium when an option is traded?
questions.why: The buyer pays the premium and the seller receives it up front.

questions.q: A call seller makes the full premium if, at expiry, the stock is:
questions.why: A call below its strike expires worthless, so the seller keeps everything.

questions.q: Lot size 500, premium ₹6. How much does the seller receive for one lot?
INFY is at ₹1,500. Which of these calls is out of the money?
questions.why: A call is OTM when its strike is above the stock price.

questions.q: What happens to an in-the-money stock option left open at expiry in India?
options: It settles by physical delivery of shares
questions.why: Stock options settle by physical delivery, which is why Theta Desk exits 7 days before expiry.
